## ChainSimulationConfig type

Per-chain backend capabilities. Exactly one configuration shape per chain; the discriminated union enforces that \*\*at least one\*\* of `tenderlyRpc` (primary) or `simulateV1Url` (fallback) is supplied.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type ChainSimulationConfig = {
    tenderlyRpc: TenderlyRpcConfig;
    simulateV1Url?: string;
} | {
    tenderlyRpc?: TenderlyRpcConfig;
    simulateV1Url: string;
};
```
**References:** [TenderlyRpcConfig](./evm-simulation.tenderlyrpcconfig.md)
